summary: Beamr Imaging filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a routine current report) furnishing a Q3-2026 CEO shareholder letter dated November 12, 2026, signed by CEO Sharon Carmel. The letter reiterates guidance of roughly 50% revenue growth in 2026 to about $4.5 million, citing existing contracts, renewals, and a three-year renewal with a major global streaming platform running through October 2029. It discusses AV/ML-Safe strategy and 12 autonomous-vehicle engagements. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics. No special situation is present; this is ordinary corporate communication with incorporation by reference into registration statements.
